title: Chinese-American World War II Veteran Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Chinese-American World War II Veteran Congressional Gold Medal Act

(Sec. 4) This bill directs the President pro tempore of the Senate and the Speaker of the House of Representatives to make appropriate arrangements for the award of a single Congressional Gold Medal to the Chinese-American Veterans of World War II in recognition of their dedicated service during World War II.

The medal shall be displayed at the Smithsonian Institution, which is urged to make the medal available for display at other locations associated with such veterans or with World War II.

summary.headline: This law directs Congress leaders to arrange a single Congressional Gold Medal honoring Chinese-American World War II veterans, to be displayed at the Smithsonian Institution.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the President pro tempore of the Senate and the Speaker of the House to make arrangements for awarding one Congressional Gold Medal to Chinese-American veterans of World War II. It recognizes their service during the war. The medal is to be displayed at the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is encouraged to lend the medal for display at other places tied to these veterans or to World War II.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2018.
